title: Landscape genomics of the invasive common tansy and its consequences for range shifts
author: Briscoe Runquist, Ryan
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Collect field samples
steps.instruction: Sample a total of 176 individual common tansy plants across the expanding range in Minnesota, USA, and include additional individuals from the native range in Finland for completeness.

steps.title: Generate reduced‑representation libraries
steps.instruction: Perform reduced‑representation sequencing on all collected samples to obtain genome‑wide data.

steps.title: Create genotype file with Stacks
steps.instruction: Run the Stacks 2.59 denovo pipeline on the sequencing reads, then execute the populations module, retaining loci that are present in at least 70 % of populations and have a minor allele frequency of ≥1 %, producing a genotype file containing 3071 polymorphic loci for the 176 individuals.

substeps.instruction: Run Stacks 2.59 denovo pipeline on raw reads.
Run the populations function with filters: –min‑populations 0.70 (70 % of populations) and –min‑maf 0.01 (1 % minor allele frequency).
